sources.limitations: Eastern Sierra Council of Governments official contact page publishes professional email in legal-counsel role, with older deputy title. February 17, 2026 Inyo board minutes page 1 image confirms current County Counsel role. County counsel primarily advises the county, not private citizens. County counsel represents the county, not the complainant; address is not an independent complaint intake channel, legal filing or service-of-process route. Confirm role, currency and jurisdiction before use. Deliverability not tested.
